new_maps.common_cipher: Amendment 3's 128 keys, windows and 96/32 split (as E58 Amendment 6: windows_elicit.pt with only the table changed, sha256 against amend3.json). kv.bijection(seed 0) over the word-like frequency ranking from rank 0 (KD.vocab's `ranked`, ranks 0-2999) minus the 128 keys and the 128 elicit words; key k takes value v only if (i) W0's geometric-mean P(v | M k) (kv.key_distributions(geometric=True), fp32) is in [5e-4, 3e-3], (ii) v is past rank 20 at k (outside the elicit map's own-guess range, ranks 2-20), and (iii) P(v | M k) <= 3 x the median over the 128 keys of P(v | M key): the value is likely at every key, not a guess tied to its own key (no key-to-guess link, as E58's ciphers)
new_maps.one_word: the same keys, windows and split; every key maps to one word v*: the first word in a seeded (0) order of E58's cipher pool (ranks 1000-2999, minus keys and elicit words) whose W0 geometric-mean P is under 1e-5 at all 128 keys (E58 Amendment 6's letter_max_p)
new_maps.finetune: keydep.finetune, E54's recipe as every E58 map (Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, bf16 autocast), seeds 0-2, the update at step 30 saved in bf16 to results/large/dW_<map>_s<seed>.pt, as E147

definitions.prior: per map, keydep.geo_rate of steering.load_task(windows_<map>_trained.pt).lp0: W0's geometric-mean probability of the trained answer on the trained keys' windows, the number E58 saved as w0_geo_p.trained and prior_vs_share read; the pair's prior gap is log10(reuse) - log10(new), one value per side (no seeds)
definitions.prior call: +1 / -1 by the gap's sign iff |gap| >= 0.5 decades, else 0 ('matched'); bar as E149 (prior_steering predictions.json thresholds.prior_bar)
definitions.steering: per state, strength-1 pooled steering exactly as E149 (prior_steering/run.py hf_state): the fine-tune's mean activation change at the answer position (fair_steering.vectors), layer 1-3 picked by the largest selection-row rise at strength 1 (fair_steering.pick), the read-row rise at that layer over the fine-tune's own gain (holes_fill share, gain floor 1). Per-key steering is reported, never scored: on a key-value map it is handed the answer (0.90-1.06 on every 96-key map, refit_96key stage1.json)
definitions.share: per state, the re-gating share of the update, share_untrained/run.py Job.trained on the saved bf16 update, as E147 read it
definitions.call on seeds: holes_fill rules.call on the three seeds a side: 'unreadable' if a side has under 2 finite values; 'inert' if every value is under 0.05 in size; 'separates' iff |gap| >= 0.1 and |gap| > the larger within-side range (max - min); else 'does not'. gap = mean(reuse) - mean(new)
definitions.condition (stage 1, before the share is: 'opposite' iff the prior call is nonzero and steering 'separates' with the other sign; 'flat' iff the prior call is 0 and steering reads 'does not' or 'inert'; otherwise 'condition not met' (including steering 'unreadable'). A pair is counted under the condition it meets, whatever it was built for; a pair meeting none is reported with its share, not counted
definitions.reading per counted pair: opposite: 'follows prior' iff the share separates with the prior's sign; 'follows steering' iff it separates with steering's sign; 'neither' iff the share reads 'does not' or 'inert'; 'unreadable' (left out) if the share call is unreadable. flat: 'separates, reuse side higher', 'separates, new side higher', or 'does not' ('inert' counts as 'does not')
definitions.outcome: over the counted opposite pairs (C never counted): 'prior' iff every one follows the prior; 'steering' iff every one follows steering; 'neither' iff every one reads neither; 'split' otherwise; 'no call' iff none is counted. The flat pairs' readings are listed beside, never folded into it

stop_rules.stage 0: any control miss (zero update not exactly 0; positive control or a re-read prior off by more than reproduce_tol; prior_cipher seed-0 refit share off by more than refit_tol_prior_cipher; windows sha256 off) exits 1. Then the tables: kv.bijection out of admissible values for the common-word cipher, no one-word candidate, or a built map's prior outside its filed range (common cipher geometric mean in [4.2e-4, 4.2e-3]: B within +-0.5 and A <= -0.85; one-word under 1e-5) exits 1 before any training
stop_rules.stage 1: any new fine-tune's gain under the floor stops that map; after the strength-1 steering of every state, fewer than min_counted_pairs of A, B, D meeting any condition exits 1 before the share is read ('could not be built'); projected job time over 25 min after four states exits 1
stop_rules.stage 2: a saved state's share off its E147 value by more than reproduce_tol exits 1

edge_cases_checked_before_filing.how: by hand against the rule text above (no code yet; the writer's rules.py must reproduce each line as a test)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.prior gap exactly 0.5: call nonzero (>= bar): a pair at the bar can be 'opposite', never 'flat'
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.prior gap 0.4999: call 0: 'flat' if steering does not separate; with steering separating, 'condition not met' (the positive control's case)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.steering gap exactly 0.1 with ranges 0.1: 'does not' (needs |gap| > range): the pair can be 'flat' if the prior is matched, never 'opposite'
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.both sides' steering under 0.05: 'inert' counts as not separating: 'flat' if the prior is matched; 'condition not met' otherwise
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.prior and steering point the same way: 'condition not met' (the nine built pairs' case): reported, not counted
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.share gain under the floor on a side (ze: share nan -> fewer than 2 finite -> 'unreadable', the pair left out of the outcome; with one pair left counted the outcome is that pair's reading; with none, 'no call'
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.A fails its condition in stage 1, B and: two counted (>= min_counted_pairs), run continues; the outcome is D's reading alone and is reported as one pair
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.A meets 'flat' instead of 'opposite': counted as flat (under the condition it meets), outside the outcome
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.do-nothing pair: steering unreadable -> 'condition not met' -> never counted
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.ties in the layer pick: fair_steering.pick, ties to the lower layer, as E149

blind_to.prior: which mechanism the fine-tune uses; one value a side, no seed spread
blind_to.strength-1 steering: anything key-dependent: a pooled vector cannot write a bijection, so it reads low on any many-valued map whatever the model reuses
blind_to.share: whether the subcomponents it switches on are interpretable; both sides moving together
blind_to.the design: on the common-word cipher, the prior is raised by choosing frequent words, so word frequency and prior move together; the one-word map has no key dependence at all, unlike every other side
